theorems.name: Submission.frt_vgm_ext_finite_of_lintegral_continuous
theorems.statement: ∀ (X : Type) [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace.PseudoMetrizableSpace X] [MeasurableSpace X] [BorelSpace X] (m₁ m₂ : Measure X), IsFiniteMeasure m₁ → (∀ β : C(X, ℝ), (∀ x, 0 ≤ β x) → ∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (β x) ∂m₁ = ∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (β x) ∂m₂) → m₁ = m₂
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
